_note: The site's public address. Change url when the site moves to its own domain (for example https://hoopstats.my/); every page's canonical link, preview card and the sitemap follow it. google_verification is the content of Google Search Console's HTML-tag verification, if you use that method. gate_sha256: the SHA-256 of the password every visitor must enter (the password screen); leave it empty to open the site to everyone.
